Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling eastbound in the left-hand lane of a multi-lane arterial in Houston, Texas, and was turning left
at the intersection when the collision occurred. Driver 2 was proceeding westbound and struck the front driver's side
of the vehicle operated by Driver 1. Driver 1 reported that a passenger was seated in the front right position at the
time of impact. I arrived on scene and confirmed the presence of that passenger, and the statements gathered from
the parties at the scene were consistent on this point. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the
vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and was evaluated on scene before being transported for further care.
The described injuries are consistent with the mechanism of a side impact of this type. Damage to the vehicle,
including the deformed front driver's side panel and displaced wheel assembly, mathces the impact described by all
parties. Scene photographs taken by officers corroborate several of the details provided, although no independent
witnesses came forward. Records available to me show no prior damage to the vehicle in this area.
